name: tomato-code-root
description: Root orchestrator for Tomato Code services

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix services/admin && npm install --prefix services/auth && npm install --prefix services/realtime && npm install --prefix services/restaurant && npm install --prefix services/rider && npm install --prefix services/utils
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "frontend,admin,auth,realtime,restaurant,rider,utils" -c "cyan,magenta,blue,yellow,green,red,gray" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix services/admin" "npm run dev --prefix services/auth" "npm run dev --prefix services/realtime" "npm run dev --prefix services/restaurant" "npm run dev --prefix services/rider" "npm run dev --prefix services/utils"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -n "admin,auth,realtime,restaurant,rider,utils" -c "magenta,blue,yellow,green,red,gray" "npm run dev --prefix services/admin" "npm run dev --prefix services/auth" "npm run dev --prefix services/realtime" "npm run dev --prefix services/restaurant" "npm run dev --prefix services/rider" "npm run dev --prefix services/utils"
